_comment: Retirement Missing Vowels: complete answers plus the clue that reaches each one. The letter band, the word limit and the clue budget arrive on the request because the page fixes all three before a word exists (frontend levels.ts / layout.ts). The page prints A E I O U as blanks itself, so the model must never send a pre-blanked form; Y is not a vowel. minVowels is the number of blanks a row needs to be a puzzle rather than a spelling test. varietyAngles rotate by seed so two sellers on one theme get different word sets.
